author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
It's time for Adam to sink his teeth into a big and ambitious paint job. Inspired by the use of alcohol inks at effects shops he's recently visited, Adam tackles the painting of a large 3D-printed crab creature designed by artist Paul Braddock. Adam's inspiration and reference for the paint scheme? Blue lobsters!

Paul Braddock's 3D models: https://www.paul-braddock.com/collections/3d-print-files
